answer: To resist sybils, agents post a locked stake that funds a mandatory voyage of 64 sequential SHA-256 iterations bound to their pubkey and the epoch seed; each step must be attested by peers before the next, creating a ripple of irreversible compute cost. Spawning extra identities requires repeating the full voyage per clone, and any detected parallelism or reuse triggers immediate sable of the entire bond to the treasury, making mass sybil creation economically ruinous.
